Nina (People Ops): Hiring manager flagged a comp-change for a lateral transfer + title change (SWE II -> SWE II+). Effective 2026-04-10. Is this a promotion for payroll/equity purposes or just title change?
Caleb (Hiring Mgr): It was an internal lateral with small comp bump to match market. Manager said no equity change, just base bump and title tweak.
Javier (Payroll): If base increases, treat as comp change. For equity unchanged, mark equity_action as NO_CHANGE. Payroll will apply base change per eff_date; if approved after cutoff, a retro will occur.
Nina (People Ops): What about eligibility for next-level calibration? Will this trigger leveling review?
Javier (Payroll): Title change triggers org update but not automatic leveling. People Ops should flag in the calibration spreadsheet if manager requests formal leveling review.
Workday-bot: Change request created: WD-CHG-2026-04-10-993. Add to payload and include manager_approval.
Caleb (Hiring Mgr): Thanks. We'll send the CSV and attach WD change ID in the ticket.
Nina (People Ops): Also note for the comms we should say "title updated to SWE II+ with market adjustment" and include eff_date and whether retro will appear.
Javier (Payroll): Good. If manager wants no retro, we need signed waiver from employee acknowledging delayed effective pay.
Nina (People Ops): Noted. I'll draft comms. :)
